mintAuthority.headline: Issuer multisigs permit uncapped minting; monthly BDO reports reconcile reserves and liabilities, while signer independence remains unverified.
mintAuthority.summary: COPM is natively issued on Polygon, Celo and Solana. Issuer Safes hold the EVM mint, role-admin and upgrade powers; a Squads vault governs Solana issuance. Minting has no on-chain collateral bound. BDO limited-assurance reports reconcile bank reserves with liabilities on all three chains; signer independence and off-chain key custody remain unverified.

controls.label: Polygon issuer Safe mint and role administration
controls.evidence: At polygon block 97385031 (0xb13e13a688d06dcd24aa512c2f8c1351d5b4bbb8dec582efd2d97b902d1d9402, 2026-11-15T22:50:16+00:00), getRoleMemberCount/getRoleMember enumerate this Safe as the sole DEFAULT_ADMIN, MINTER, UPGRADER, FREEZER, PAUSER and RESCUER member; every role admin is DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. Verified TokenV1.mint(address,uint256) calls _mint with arbitrary recipient/amount and no deposit, bridge-message or reserve check. _authorizeUpgrade is onlyRole(UPGRADER_ROLE). The Safe returns threshold 3, 8 owners and VERSION 1.3.0; getModulesPaginated returns no modules with sentinel next, guard and module-guard storage read zero, and the nonzero fallback handler is retained explicitly. No token-level timelock is enforced. Signer beneficial independence and off-chain key custody were not established; fallback reach has no complete execution certificate.

controls.evidence: At exact finalized slot 469903332, the mint, vault, Squads multisig, program and ProgramData response contexts match the pin; before/after headers match blockhash FYR3CTDzcHebFobRJN4eSNSnVJwBTyWr3UqQZMTzCnLD, 2026-11-15T22:50:55Z. COPM is a two-decimal Token-2022 mint whose mint/freeze/metadata-update/permanent-delegate authority is this off-curve PDA. The vault is System Program-owned with empty data; that alone does not make it a keypair. Squads V4 program SQDS4ep65T869zMMBKyuUq6aD6EgTu8psMjkvj52pCf owns multisig BDNkaXZQkTogoKR9TWnwApyBTsinWtsxfPNntG8dRFsb. Its matching Anchor Multisig discriminator decodes threshold 2, seven distinct members each with initiate/vote/execute permission mask 7, time_lock 0 and default/null config_authority. SHA-256 Solana PDA derivation with published multisig/vault seeds, vault index 0 and bump 255 exactly yields the token authority. A finalized historical transaction at slot 248202995 executes native MintToChecked through this Squads vault, supporting native issuance rather than bridge proof minting. ProgramData Fy3YMJCvwbAXUgUM5b91ucUVA3jYzwWLHL3MwBqKsh8n records last upgrade slot 302582236 and Option::None upgrade authority at the current exact pin. Member addresses are retained in the research packet; distinct keys establish topology, not human independence or hardware custody. Spending-limit and full execution-scope closure are not certified.

upgradeability.controlRef: Polygon issuer Safe mint implementation upgrades

review.evidence: Primary issuer directory and blockchain controls, verified deployed TokenV1 implementations, complete enumerable role rosters and pinned Safe state establish direct issuer native minting on both EVM chains. Exact-slot Solana mint, vault, multisig and immutable-program account reads, exact PDA derivation and historical native MintToChecked execution establish a Squads-controlled Token-2022 issuance authority. Both TokenV1 versions allow arbitrary-recipient minting without collateral checks, and current role members can replace mint-critical logic. Monthly BDO AUDIT S.A.S. BIC ISAE 3000 limited-assurance reports compare all Polygon, Celo and Solana COPM liabilities with bank reserves: the August 31, 2026 report, signed October 19, covers COP 6,768,005,179.37 token liabilities and COP 7,057,743,676.39 cash. This supports periodic reconciliation and attestation-only supervision, not prudential authorization or a financial-statement audit. No current incident absence or complete execution closure is claimed.
